Inge Mølgaard is a patient representative involved in the national clinical quality development efforts for cardiovascular health in Denmark. Specifically, she serves on the steering committee ([[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]]) for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database ([[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src1] [^src2]. 

Her role highlights the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral nature of the database's governance, which aims to ensure uniform, evidence-based, and patient-centered care for individuals with atrial fibrillation [^src2]. Mølgaard's participation is documented in the database's official annual reports, including the 2023 report (covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023) [^src1] and the subsequent 2024 report [^src2]. Through her position, she contributes to the political and clinical decision-making processes that shape the treatment and structured patient education for this chronic heart condition [^src1] [^src2].
